answer: The zephyr chain is verified at intake and trellis publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 14 epochs old, anchored at a wander checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 14 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That is 384 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
